target_customer: Product teams, designers and product managers; later teams building coding agents
problem: Originally lightweight sprint planning for distributed dev teams; later helping non-technical staff prototype on existing products with coding agents and benchmarking agent design quality.
business_model: Software subscription, later outcome-based pricing and benchmark or eval services
product_category: Product planning software, later AI design workspace and benchmark

founders.name: Ehud Halberstam
prior_employers: InVision (led Brand.ai, which became InVision DSM, 2017 to 2022)
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

founders.name: Amit Bar
prior_employers: InVision (engineering manager then director of engineering)
founders.background_notes: Left InVision in 2022 per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: The original sprint planner was standard web software; later products need repo cloning and compilation for coding agents, which adds moderate difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Planning boards are easily copied by Jira, Linear and others, and the later agent tooling is a fast-moving space.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent planning tools remained dominant; Chordio pivoted away from sprint planning rather than being acquired.

market_need_then: Remote development teams needed sprint capacity planning, but sources opened give no dated evidence of unmet demand beyond the founders' own claims in the 2023 YC launch post.

identity.voice_and_tone: Modern developer-tool tone; Design Rails product marketed as AI-native brand kits

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches for Design Rails drew comments that generated logos looked generic.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is musical and distinctive but resembles Cordio Medical and Chordio-like terms in search, hurting findability; little brand evidence otherwise.

pivots.from: Lightweight sprint planner for remote development teams (YC launch post)
pivots.to: Claude Code design workspace for product teams, then PX-bench benchmark for coding agents
pivots.why: Not stated; dates of the later changes are not stated in sources

outcome_analysis: Chordio, a Summer 2022 company with experienced founders from the Brand.ai and InVision exit, launched a sprint planner in 2023, then repeatedly repositioned toward AI-era design workflows and a coding-agent benchmark. No funding, revenue or exit is public and the team is four people, so the company appears small and still searching for a fit, though 'failed pivot' is not established.
notes: No funding found; search results were polluted by Cordio Medical, a different company. Crunchbase returned 403. The YC page describes a Claude Code workspace while the website describes PX-bench, so the YC page may be stale. Competitor list left empty because no source dated near the 2022 batch was found; 2026 listicles name Jira, Linear, Productboard and Aha but are not dated to founding. The 'pivot_failed' factor is tentative and unproven. Founder technical flag for Halberstam unknown.
